I am an undergraduate reading Physics with a second major in Data Analytics at NUS. My work
sits where numerical methods meet experimental physics: writing the simulation or the analysis
pipeline, and then checking it against something measured.

This site collects my coursework projects. Each one includes the code, the figures it
generated, and the written report.

## Projects

### [Driven Quadruple Pendulum](projects/quadruple-pendulum/index.qmd)
Chaotic dynamics of four coupled masses. A hand-coded RK4 integrator, validated against SciPy's
adaptive solver, then characterised with Poincaré sections, bifurcation diagrams and Lyapunov
divergence.

### [Quantum Bouncer](projects/quantum-bouncer/index.qmd)
A quantum particle in a gravitational potential, propagated exactly on an Airy-function
eigenbasis, showing wave-packet spreading and quantum revivals.

### [Experimental Physics](projects/experimental-physics/index.qmd)
Four laboratory experiments: electron spin resonance, Gaussian beam optics, the Hall effect in
germanium, and X-ray diffraction of crystals.
